sections.title: Engagement progress
sections.sql: select code,name,partner,due_date,unreviewed,outstanding_requests,open_notes from engagement_progress order by due_date

sections.title: Workpaper queue
sections.sql: select engagement,code,name,owner,risk,status,due_date,open_notes from review_queue order by due_date

sections.title: Client evidence chase
sections.sql: select engagement,code,name,owner,status,due_date,days_late from request_chase order by due_date

sections.title: Review prompts, not an audit opinion
sections.sql: select kind,reference,rule,detail from documentation_checks order by reference,rule
